services.label: Our Services
services.title: Custom Development Services
services.subtitle: From code to deployment: the services your business needs to grow.

items.title: Enterprise Software & Internal Systems
items.description: Spreadsheet migrations, custom ERPs, and complete control over inventory, purchasing, and sales.
items.longDescription: We design and build enterprise platforms that replace scattered Excel sheets and costly off-the-shelf software. We centralize inventory, sales, purchasing, finance, and HR into a secure, fast, and accessible system.
highlights: Full spreadsheet migration to a secure database
Integrated inventory, purchasing, and sales control
Granular employee roles and custom permissions
24/7 cloud access from mobile and desktop

items.title: AI Implementation for Business
items.description: 24/7 intelligent assistants, automated invoice extraction, and custom AI automation grounded in your actual data.
items.longDescription: We integrate cutting-edge language models and private models grounded on your company manuals, catalogs, and policies. Accurate answers with zero hallucinations, automated data extraction, and computer vision.
highlights: 24/7 customer support with your real knowledge base (RAG)
Automated data extraction from invoices and PDFs
Audio transcription and meeting minutes
Computer vision and automated quality control

items.title: Web & Mobile App Development
items.description: Sub-second load websites that convert visitors, payment gateways, and mobile apps for iOS and Android.
items.longDescription: We build modern digital experiences, ranging from high-conversion landing pages to full SaaS platforms and mobile apps on iOS and Android with single-codebase efficiency.
highlights: Sub-second load speed across all screen viewports
iOS and Android mobile apps in Flutter and React
Payment checkout integration (Stripe, cards, bank transfers)
Engineered for high search engine visibility (SEO)

items.title: Cybersecurity & Tech Advisory
items.description: Hardening for existing software, vulnerability auditing, automated offsite backups, and bank-grade data encryption.
items.longDescription: Digital security is essential to safeguard your business from ransomware, database breaches, and regulatory fines. We audit existing systems, shield APIs, and advise leadership before major technical investments.
highlights: Security auditing and hardening for existing systems
Bank-grade encryption for credentials and records
Automated offsite disaster recovery backups
Honest senior tech consultation before investing

items.title: UI/UX Design & User Experience
items.description: Intuitive software that needs no manual, clickable prototypes before coding, and mobile-first ergonomic layouts.
items.longDescription: Great design makes complex software feel effortless. We build interactive Figma prototypes so you can test user flows before writing code, ensuring frictionless conversions and brand consistency.
highlights: Interactive prototypes to test before coding
Intuitive flows that reduce customer support tickets
Ergonomic single-handed mobile design
Scalable design systems and brand consistency

items.title: Automation, Analytics & Reporting
items.description: WhatsApp automation, multi-tool API connections, manual task elimination, and live executive dashboards.
items.longDescription: We bridge your business tools into seamless automated workflows. We connect your store with WhatsApp, payment gateways, electronic invoicing, and inventory so sales process automatically with real-time KPI visibility.
highlights: Automated WhatsApp notifications and confirmations
Elimination of repetitive manual data entry
Real-time revenue and sales performance dashboards
Multi-tool connection using APIs and Webhooks
